ABOUT Princess Tower:
At 414 meters the Princess Tower holds the world record for the world's tallest residential building. It is roughly equivalent in height to the Empire State Building in New York. It was originally to be named Al Ameera Tower but the English translation, Princess Tower, was chosen instead. Princess Tower was originally planned to be just 90 stories and the height was purely a means to maximize the profit on a relatively small plot of land. It was only later into the design process that the developers realized a potential word record was within reach, so the tower was re-designed at the last minute to allow for a further 11 floors.
The tower is positioned slightly closer to the sea than its direct neighbors. That was done to maximize the sea views for the side apartments and explains why it appears off-center on its podium.

Company name: AX Capital Website: https://www.axcapital.ae/
ABOUT Princess Tower:
At 414 meters the Princess Tower holds the world record for the world's tallest residential building. It is roughly equivalent in height to the Empire State Building in New York. It was originally to be named Al Ameera Tower but the English translation, Princess Tower, was chosen instead. Princess Tower was originally planned to be just 90 stories and the height was purely a means to maximize the profit on a relatively small plot of land. It was only later into the design process that the developers realized a potential word record was within reach, so the tower was re-designed at the last minute to allow for a further 11 floors.
The tower is positioned slightly closer to the sea than its direct neighbors. That was done to maximize the sea views for the side apartments and explains why it appears off-center on its podium.

property.title_en: Brand New Two-Bedroom Apartment in Meydan One
property.description_en:
AX CAPITAL Real Estate is delighted to present this beautiful two-bedroom apartment in Azizi Riviera for sale, situated in the popular development area of Meydan City.
Unit Details:
- 2 Bedroom - 2 Bathrooms / 1 Main + Guest - Parking Space - Reference no. axc-3961540
Riviera is one of Azizi’s flagship developments located in Meydan at the heart of Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City) in Dubai. In a prime location, close to Meydan Racecourse, the home of The Dubai World Cup and various sports and leisure facilities, Riviera offers a desirable address and is close to Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport. Inspired by the French Riviera, the iconic mixed-use community will be home to residential apartments, retail outlets, and various onsite amenities.
Riviera comprises various mid-rise residential buildings with various retail outlets at the ground floor level. Each individual building will benefit from a swimming pool, landscaped gardens, and a gym. Key attractions will include a beautiful crystal lagoon and beach spanning 2km, a beautiful palm tree-lined boulevard, and numerous community parks. Residential properties include studios, one, two, and three-bedroom apartments offering a variety of different views ranging from orientation towards Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa to community pool and canal views. Dubai Creek Harbor is a new world-class waterfront destination on the banks of the historic Dubai Creek and the wondrous Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. Seamlessly integrating state-of-the-art homes with nature, this city within the city offers up a brand-new concept of "Urban Luxe' living.
The Grand at Dubai Creek Harbor is a 62-story residential building situated near the heart of the dazzling Creek Island, one of Dubai Creek Harbor's nine distinct neighborhoods. Sitting strategically at the intersection of the waterfront between the marina and the promenade, the skyscraper will be near both Al Khail Road and Ras Al Khor Road.
The development offers a mix of one-two- and three-bedroom apartments as well as penthouses and villas.
Amenities will include a gymnasium, a multi-purpose sports area, a tennis court, an infinity pool, cabanas, children's play areas, and outdoor barbecue areas.
From The Grand at Dubai Creek Harbor, it takes roughly 15 minutes to drive to Dubai Mall, 26 minutes to Palm Jumeirah, 24 minutes to Burj Al Arab, and 29 minutes to The Walk JBR.
Dubai International Airport (DXB) is roughly 18 minute drive and the new Al Maktoum International Airport is roughly 46 minutes drive. All durations are calculated by Google Maps and assume the fastest route in typical traffic conditions.

- High Floor - 3 beds plus extra room - 4 bathrooms - 2 parking - Reference No. axc-3759333
Designed with residents and investors in mind, Stella Maris is an engineered jewel fashioned for those who appreciate a posh lifestyle. The development has direct access to the Marina Walk and panoramic views of the Marina Canal and Arabian Gulf Sea.
Stella Maris is situated in a popular destination with global recognition, due to its prime waterfront location. This area hosts multiple restaurants, cafés, and entertainment options, providing its residents a chance to experience the best that life has to offer in a luxurious waterfront setting.

agent.name: Jelena Jakovlevic
agent.info:

Elena has been a resident in Dubai for 10 years and visited many countries in the world. While traveling, she realized her love for architecture and interior design, which eventually led her to redirect her career to real estate.
Elena quickly found her way in the industry and in Ax Capital. With personal experience investing in Dubai real estate, she understands the importance of negotiating and protecting the interests of her clients.
She shares experience, knowledge and support with all her clients with equal dedication, regardless of the transaction budget.
She specializes in sales and rental of finished properties on the prestigious Palm Jumeirah island. Successfully represents buyers and sellers, fully justifying the trust of both parties.

agent.info:
David grew up in Staffordshire, UK. He studied Business and Marketing at Northamptonshire University and holds a BA with Honors.

A little about personal life
David's main passion is food. His dream is to retire to the North coast of Devon and open a restaurant by the sea. He won Junior Master Chef in the UK when he was young. David loves the ocean, surfing, fitness and leads a healthy lifestyle. He has also climbed Mount Kilimanjaro.
